name: watch-your-step
description: 🛘🥾 A PreToolUse hook that checks each command before it runs. Silent-corruption traps — backticks in double quotes, commits with conflict markers, discarded uncommitted work, unrecoverable branch deletions — are blocked with the exact fix; risky habits like git add -A only warn. A git-level guard also refuses unrecoverable branch deletions by any route. Override a rule once: # wys:allow <rule>.
